column1: # Claims: what each record item says is true, and where it is checked (ADR-0019, Proposed; COUPLING.md §3.1).
# One row per claim, tab-separated. The verdicts are in the row lists and the digests in the results files; this
# table names rows and restates neither. Nothing reads this file yet: the claims check is ADR-0020, Proposed.
#   claim     a stable id, never reused: C-<record>-<item><letter>, or C-<record>-h<n> for a claim made in a History row
#   record    the record item that makes the claim
#   says      the claim in one line, as the record words it
#   module    the module that checks it
#   property  the operator the rows check
#   rows      the rows that check it; each row list expects HOLDS of every one
#   breaks    the rows whose counterexample shows the claim is not vacuous (expected COUNTEREXAMPLE); - if no row does
#   grade     checked (TLC, every reachable state at the row's constants), proved, certified, sampled, or abstracted
#             (the module abstracts it away and says why; nothing checks it in TLA+)
# Not claims, and marked here so that the check of ADR-0020 can tell them from a property no record decided on:
#   PinLifecycle   TypeOK, Safe (the conjunction of the invariants below), NoBehaviour (the fair spec has a behaviour),
#                  and the witnesses Never* (each state the records rely on is reached)
#   ProveRequests  Safe, NoBehaviour, and the witnesses Never*
#   C-0016-4c is abstracted: ADR-0016 item 4 lists it as a property, and ProveRequests.tla's header says it holds by
#     construction at the module's abstraction. The server's tests exercise it (server/test_prove.py).
#   C-0016-h1 is made in a History row of ADR-0016 (2026.11.16, the custodian's choice that the server reaps every
#     child), not in a numbered item, so it has no item to cite.
#   Five PinLifecycle claims (4d to 4g, 4i) and one ProveRequests claim (4h) have no breaking row: no mutation removes
#     what they rest on. Their witnesses show the states they constrain are reached; a mutation each would show

column3: says
Every release's evidence was run on the image the release publishes
A prover value is built only from its kept copy
Every release can be rebuilt: each of its pins is still served, or is kept here
Every digest a project has ever pinned is in the registry, or was withdrawn with a record
From its first publish on, a tag names one digest
A release's version part fits the kind of pin it moved
Every merged pull request moves one pin, or the base and the snapshot together
Each log entry is filed under the value it is about
No log entry changes once it is filed
Every change upstream is eventually reported, under weak fairness of the weekly check
Each request gets at most one response, and nothing after it
A success response needs a run that ended by itself and complete
The answer's scope is the request's scope
When a response is sent, no process the request started is still alive
No two live processes write the same cache directory
Nothing is written into the project
Every request is eventually answered or cancelled
A request waiting for a cache eventually runs
The server reaps every child a request started, not only tlapm
